$Comment: The Restless Moon: a full moon (Seasons_Of_Orbis_Full_Moon) while Hallow's Eve is not running.
The file name is the event id. It is a condition, not a run, so it has no dates, attendance or
Almanac page. During Hallow's Eve it is never live, so an October full moon belongs to Old Jack's
Content for a full moon outside Hallow's Eve names it in its Season leaf: the Gravekeeper's full
Herald.Start is the banner as the moon rises, telling players where the Gravekeeper keeps watch.
OncePerDay shows it to each player at most once a day, counted in UTC since no Clock is written,
however many full moons the day holds; a player who joins while it is up sees it then. There is
no End banner, so the moon sets quietly.
